$comment: What any good explanation of this PR says, written by a model from the PR's title, description and diff only (scripts/eval-assertions.ts). The eval grades each run against them. Delete one that is wrong; keep them stable so evals compare.

assertions.text: Says that the PR adds a DELETE /folders endpoint that deletes many of a user's folders in one request, replacing one call per folder.
Says that deleting a folder re-assigns the ciphers filed under it to no folder (unfiled) rather than deleting the ciphers.
Says that the controller delegates to a DeleteManyFoldersCommand, which calls a new repository DeleteManyAsync method implemented separately for Dapper and Entity Framework.
Says that the SQL Server implementation is a new Folder_DeleteByIds stored procedure, added with a migration script, run within a transaction from Dapper.
Says that ids of folders the user does not own are silently ignored, so only the caller's own folders are deleted.
Says that after deletion the command sends a single full vault sync push instead of per-folder delete notifications, because ciphers were also changed.
Says that the endpoint is gated behind the VFO1 feature flag and limits cloud requests to 500 folder ids, while self-hosted has no limit.
Says that the user's folder assignment is also cleared on organization ciphers shared with the user, since the folder mapping is stored per user in the cipher's Folders JSON.
Does not claim that deleting a folder also deletes the ciphers inside it.
Does not claim that the endpoint can delete other users' folders or raises an error when given ids the user does not own.
